caption: Olivet University v. Candappa
citation_line: Olivet University v. Candappa, No. 2:25-cv-18777, ECF No. 25 (D.N.J. Sept. 2, 2026)
headnote_district_ruling: Transferred a defamation action against a Newsweek employee to the Southern District of New York under § 1404(a), emphasizing the near-identical action pending there, the locus of publication, consent to personal jurisdiction, and the policy against duplicative litigation.
qualification_rationale: A current, concrete Jumara analysis for media defendants and parallel defamation suits filed in neighboring federal districts.
appellate_posture_note: Transfer order entered eleven days before the cutoff; no substantive appellate review identified.
